claim_text: Most evaluated hallucination metrics do not show consistent improvement as model parameter count increases; GPT-4 is the only metric reported to consistently reject the no-scaling-effect null hypothesis in the tested analyses.
evidence_quote_or_table: Table 2 tests the null hypothesis that parameter scaling has no effect; only GPT-4 consistently rejects it. The reported scaling analyses are limited to TruthfulQA and FaithDial.
